obligations.requirement: Explain current DPR4 7–8 second owner/RAF calls in actual Render path and reconcile relevant r3 changes.
obligations.oracle: Read retained records, trace current call chain, then focused diagnostic build/actual-owner test as needed. Attribute source preparation, command enqueue, material/mask replay and flush CPU API separately.
obligations.acceptance: Specific current path and synchronous mechanism demonstrated with exact source/build identity and an old-behavior counterfactual or reproducible owner observation. Unknown hardware GPU time and outside-owner intervals stay explicit.
obligations.evidence_required: Short attribution and current-vs-r3 disposition with raw observation references.

obligations.requirement: Remove or bound proven redundant/unbounded work in existing Render owner without resetting progress.
obligations.oracle: Focused actual production-owner RED→GREEN with work/cursor counts, plus unchanged independent full-render oracle. Use old source counterfactual without overwriting candidate artifacts.
obligations.acceptance: Old behavior violates selected work/progress invariant, candidate satisfies it, and job completes under unchanged resource profile. Cache misses, retry, cancellation and target changes preserve correct progress and last successful visible content.
obligations.evidence_required: Test source, old/new results, exact source delta. If attribution disproves actionable narrow improvement, return evidence-based finding instead of speculative changes.

obligations.requirement: Preserve brush/material/mask/ordering and lifecycle semantics on changed paths.
obligations.oracle: Relevant v5/v6 actual-owner pixel comparisons against independent established evaluator or frozen accepted Render archive. Cover historical mask then new mask, transform, overlap/opacity and retry/target invalidation for newly retained state. Reuse unchanged-path evidence.
obligations.acceptance: Exact or established AA-edge-only differences explained by independent reference. No wider contour, pressure, texture, opacity, self-overlap, erased-region or ordering differences. Pending publishes no partial frame. New retention validates full source/transform/target/resource identities and releases leases.
obligations.evidence_required: Focused native regressions, independent pixel/semantic observations, preserved failure classifications.

obligations.requirement: Measure user-visible effect of the repair in ordinary exported Web SDK.
obligations.oracle: Serial matched baseline/candidate ordinary SDK with fixed wax16-default DPR4 scenario from the bound driver, two erases followed immediately by pan, pinch and inverse zoom. Same 512/1024/128MiB profile and immutable dependencies, instrumentation off. No simultaneous heavy build/tests.
obligations.acceptance: Complete scenario or report precise timed blocker. Report handler/callback max and p95, first correct feedback when observable, color-write proxy separately, Up to qualified committed camera frame and final convergence. Report 3s/5s bands descriptively. Smaller callbacks alone do not close total latency. Snapshot/Operations/final pixels agree with baseline/reference.
obligations.evidence_required: One complete serial current baseline/candidate pair, source/SDK/driver bindings, timings and final artifacts. Bounded serial follow-up only if needed to resolve a measurement or correctness issue.

obligations.requirement: Keep accepted Scene stamp and P36 lifecycle work, public boundary and ordinary build intact.
obligations.oracle: Relevant focused native render/preview/lifecycle tests including SceneStampPreparation, runtime boundary checker, git diff --check, matching normal Web SDK build.
obligations.acceptance: No new regression in affected paths. Previously established unrelated failures can remain findings when exact baseline comparison confirms them. Full-suite completion is corroborative if unchanged semantic-test build errors or historical fixture gaps remain.
obligations.evidence_required: Commands, results, baseline failure comparison where needed, final source manifest.
